rules.coverage_text: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978 (plus replacement units) in the City of Los Angeles.

exemptions.description: Condominiums and townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995

rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may increase rent only once every 12 months, by the allowable percentage set by the city.
rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase
